contracts.claim: Issuance stores a 64-character token digest, exactly the requested normalized account identity/name/role and bounded device metadata, the selected creation/expiry times and every prior live session unchanged inside the SQLite write transaction; bearer tokens never become SQL values.

Accepted lookup preserves account fields and creation time, upgrades an accepted legacy identity when needed, renews expiration only past the daily renewal threshold, and persists last-use updates atomically.
Expired, invalid-account and invalid-role sessions are removed before lookup returns no user; explicit logout removes the token digest.

Private artifact file bytes are served only with a currently authenticated session; cookie validation reads the durable per-account fingerprint so backend recreation preserves valid sessions and password changes/logout revoke access.
Windows background process options include CREATE_NO_WINDOW, optional process group and hidden startup info; non-Windows receives no Windows kwargs.

Every Popen invocation through the installed Windows safety net receives CREATE_NO_WINDOW when flags are missing/zero, while explicit keyword/positional flags and other arguments remain exact; installation is idempotent and off Windows does nothing.
X handles normalize leading @ and reject every value outside the existing 1-15 ASCII username characters before provider access.
Following enumeration returns unique case-insensitive handles within its configured account cap, accurate counts, HTTPS source provenance and exhaustion/truncation flags consistent with pagination.
Only public following accounts enter timeline requests; exactly one success or failure represents each request and all summary counts equal the collected data.
Every written source JSON equals its collected data and the manifest describes exact byte lengths and SHA-256 digests; the returned manifest digest matches the durable manifest.
Repair attempts never exceed the existing hard cap; repair/verify phase counts equal attempts actually used and verification occurs only after passed repair actions.

Completion requires a real passed detection or verification phase; proof booleans match executed phase results, tracked changes match before/after hashes and the saved receipt exactly equals the returned receipt.
An invalid repair contract returns a blocked durable receipt with its contract error and runs no command phases or claimed final verification.
After actual local worker execution, the persisted job status matches its result, all reported phase events are recorded and the repair receipt is registered as a durable artifact.
JSON wire bytes remain compact and exact through compression; gzip is used only for accepted encodings above the existing minimum response size.
Gzip request decoding never exceeds the configured maximum decompressed JSON bytes; over-limit inputs reject before dispatch.
After a request starts, its socket uses the longer request IO timeout rather than the accept-time handshake timeout, allowing a paused reader to receive the full response.

Static files remain jailed in the selected build root and return exact file bytes; only approved desktop origins receive CORS for non-page assets. Entry pages/service workers stay uncached and embedded pages retain their supported framing policy.
Successful desktop update responses are allowlisted files strictly inside the update folder and contain the exact selected file bytes; unknown or escaping names cannot select a file.

A save preserves its selected normalized storage marker and active session identity and writes the exact returned state with chronologically ordered transcript turns while the save lock remains held. A receipt-only response reports persisted session/transcript counts without echoing transcripts; a full response returns normalized stored state.

Session revisions bind only semantic session fields and the returned turn page. Equal revisions return compact notModified responses; changed or invalid revisions return the exact session/page with accurate counts.
Bootstrap returns the complete session/transcript index, only the selected bounded active turn tail, accurate projection counts and the existing lazy session-detail command.

Preparation normalizes the OpenCon GLM5.2 alias to canonical OpenRouter identity, and OpenCode Go GLM5.2/MiniMaxM3/Qwen3.7 route samples keep the selected provider while removing redundant known catalog/provider prefixes. This proves prepared identity, not provider execution.

Every timed-out, nonzero or malformed child result retains that invocation's positive process id, nonnegative measured elapsed milliseconds and ordered started/ended timestamps before raising the existing readable failure.
Terminal cleaning decodes timeout bytes as UTF-8 with replacement, removes the shared ANSI pattern and normalizes CR/CRLF to LF without losing the remaining readable text.
Prepared workflow runtime budgets default to 180 seconds, reject values outside 120-1800 and freeze the selected normalized value in the preset and every stage team contract.

Selected assistant messages exclude raw commands/command-prefixed traces, agree with finalMessage and humanized artifact summaries preserve the supplied headline, selected facts and route while dropping artifact metadata lines.

Every saved compartment preserves exactly its prior message tail plus this operator input and usable assistant answer, records a model-message or trace-only event, preserves answer provenance fields and returns exactly the persisted JSON.
